authorization: User requested a combined clean-start training run using the prior dataset and both recent legacy-related downloads.

scratch_definition.meaning: fresh pallet-task training from the official generic YOLO26n-pose initialization
scratch_definition.reason: This matches the prior G38/Y0E fresh-training convention while removing the sequential legacy-finetune dependency.

dataset.p0_tex_split_grouping: same base sample_id always in same split

spatial_stage.execution_order: after the base YOLO checkpoint is frozen
spatial_stage.architecture: exact Phase-E S1 7x7 selected-source spatial concat
spatial_stage.reason: postprocess-selected source-cell lookup is discrete; making it dense/end-to-end would be a different architecture
spatial_stage.feature_cache_reuse: forbidden; re-extract from the new YOLO
spatial_stage.dimension_input: fixed renderer-axis xyz reconstructed with perm_v4
spatial_stage.forbidden_dimension_input: stored camera-facing W/H/D because W>D reveals parity exactly
spatial_stage.selection: synthetic validation only; threshold 0.5; never select on real GT

limitations: P0 and TEX describe 20,000 distinct renders but 10,000 matched scenario IDs.
The TEX producer documentation says it replaces P0; including both is the user's challenge-track override.
The mixed validation split is not an independent paper holdout.
Phase-E S1 previously failed real diagnostic gates, so this run does not presume that retraining will improve real parity.

failed_pre_epoch_attempt.kernel_event: global OOM killed the training Python process
failed_pre_epoch_attempt.corrective_action: workers reduced to 2; all model/data/optimizer/augmentation hyperparameters unchanged
